nodes.description: Public admin address stored in RewardsDistributorDelegatorStorage; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the access-control authority.
Public pendingAdmin address declared in storage; never written in this file.
Active implementation (brains) address used as the delegatecall target for all delegated calls.
Constructor: sets admin = msg.sender, delegatecalls initialize(address) on the implementation, calls _setImplementation and finally assigns admin = admin_.
Admin-only function that validates msg.sender == admin and a non-zero address, then updates the implementation state variable and emits NewImplementation.
Internal helper that performs a low-level delegatecall to callee with data and reverts forwarding returndata on failure using assembly.
Payable fallback that delegatecalls the current implementation with msg.data and returns/reverts raw returndata via assembly.
External caller address; assigned to admin in the constructor and compared against admin in _setImplementation.
Low-level callee.delegatecall(data) executed inside delegateTo; arbitrary code runs in this contract's storage context.
Low-level implementation.delegatecall(msg.data) in the fallback; any selector is forwarded to arbitrary implementation code.
Inline assembly revert block in delegateTo that forwards raw returndata on failure.
Inline assembly returndatacopy/switch block in the fallback returning or reverting raw bytes.
Constructor argument holding the final admin address assigned at the end of the constructor.
Constructor argument ABI-encoded into the initialize(address) delegatecall payload.
Constructor argument passed both as the delegatecall target and to _setImplementation.
_setImplementation argument validated against address(0) and written to the implementation state variable.
delegateTo argument used as the delegatecall target address.
delegateTo argument containing the raw calldata forwarded to the delegatecall.
Local copy of the previous implementation address used for the NewImplementation event.
Boolean result of the delegatecall inside delegateTo, tested by inline assembly.
Raw bytes returned by the delegatecall inside delegateTo and forwarded on revert.
Boolean result of the implementation delegatecall inside the fallback, switched on by inline assembly.

edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, so the untrusted caller address flows directly into the admin state variable.
rewardToken_ is ABI-encoded via abi.encodeWithSignature and used as calldata for the initialize delegatecall.
The constructor's implementation_ argument is passed as the callee of delegateTo.
The constructor's implementation_ argument is forwarded to _setImplementation.
oldImplementation is read from the current implementation state variable before being overwritten.
_setImplementation writes the validated parameter into the implementation state variable.
The fallback reads the implementation state variable and uses it as the delegatecall target.
The callee parameter is the target address of the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
The data parameter is the raw calldata forwarded to the low-level delegatecall in delegateTo.
The success flag returned by the delegatecall is consumed by the inline assembly revert check.
returnData from the delegatecall is returned as the revert reason in the assembly block.
The fallback delegatecall success flag is consumed by the assembly switch that decides return or revert.
msg.sender must equal admin for _setImplementation to proceed; the whole privileged update is gated by msg.sender comparison.
The constructor delegates execution by calling the internal delegateTo helper.
The constructor calls _setImplementation after the initialization delegatecall.
delegateTo executes the low-level delegatecall to callee.
_setImplementation updates the implementation state variable after the admin and non-zero checks.
The fallback executes the delegatecall forwarding msg.data to the implementation.
The delegatecall in delegateTo transfers control to external code that can re-enter this contract, including the payable fallback.
The fallback's delegatecall to an arbitrary implementation can re-enter delegateTo (or any delegated function) before state effects settle.

normalization_plan.reason: admin_ is a constructor-only parameter whose sole effect is the final admin assignment; it collapses into the constructor node.
rewardToken_ is only used to build the initialize calldata consumed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
implementation_.ctor exists only as constructor input for the delegatecall target and the implementation update; it collapses into the constructor node.
implementation_.setImpl is the sole input of _setImplementation and is validated and stored by that function.
callee is the direct target address of the delegatecall unsafe operation inside delegateTo.
data is the direct calldata argument of the delegatecall unsafe operation inside delegateTo.
oldImplementation is a transient local holding the prior implementation value inside _setImplementation.
success.delegateTo is only the result flag of the delegatecall unsafe operation in delegateTo.
returnData is only consumed by the inline assembly revert block in delegateTo.
success.fallback is only the result flag of the fallback delegatecall unsafe operation.
